title: Encourage
subtitle: 「鼓勵／激勵／促進／敦促」，要先分清是在增加動力、帶來靈感、強烈勸告、提供支持，還是長期培養某種行為或態度。
description: 「鼓勵／激勵／促進／敦促」，要先分清是在增加動力、帶來靈感、強烈勸告、提供支持，還是長期培養某種行為或態度。

words.example: Clear goals can motivate students to keep improving.
words.exampleZh: 清晰目標可以激勵學生持續進步。

exercises.original: Clear goals encourage students to keep improving.
exercises.zh: 清晰目標可以激勵學生持續進步。
exercises.upgrade: Clear goals motivate students to keep improving.

options.explanation: goals provide a reason and drive to continue，motivate 最精準。
force 會表示學生被迫，和自主努力不同。
order 需要明確命令，目標本身不是命令。
allow 只是准許，不會產生行動動力。
help only 可能提供協助，但未必提升意願。
praise 是對表現作正面評價，這句沒有稱讚行為。

exercises.original: The bonus scheme encourages staff to reach their targets.
exercises.zh: 獎金制度激勵員工達成目標。
exercises.upgrade: The bonus scheme motivates staff to reach their targets.

options.explanation: bonus scheme functions as an incentive that increases effort。
allow 只表示准許員工達標。
force 會取消自願性，通常不符合 bonus incentive。
order 是主管指令，不是獎金的作用。
help 可提供資源，但 bonus 主要作用是動機。
praise only 沒有涉及金錢誘因。

exercises.original: Feedback can encourage learners to practise more regularly.
exercises.zh: 回饋可以激勵學習者更有規律地練習。
exercises.upgrade: Feedback can motivate learners to practise more regularly.
exercises.answer: motivate — feedback can increase willingness to practise，屬 motivation。

options.text: motivate — feedback can increase willingness to practise，屬 motivation。
options.explanation: feedback can increase willingness to practise，屬 motivation。

options.text: force — force 和 feedback 的支持性質不同。
options.explanation: force 和 feedback 的支持性質不同。
allow 只是給許可。
order 不是回饋。

options.text: reward necessarily — reward necessarily 未必有任何獎品。
options.explanation: reward necessarily 未必有任何獎品。

options.text: help only — help only 可能改善方法，但原句重點是增加練習意願。
options.explanation: help only 可能改善方法，但原句重點是增加練習意願。

words.example: Her story inspired many young people to continue their studies.
words.exampleZh: 她的故事鼓舞很多年輕人繼續學業。

exercises.original: Her story encouraged many young people to continue their studies.
exercises.zh: 她的故事鼓舞很多年輕人繼續學業。
exercises.upgrade: Her story inspired many young people to continue their studies.

options.explanation: a personal story creates hope and aspiration，inspire 的情感色彩最自然。
order 不是故事能做的事。
force 與榜樣式鼓舞相反。
allow 只是給予許可。
reward 需要某種回報。
help 可以支援學習，但不能表達故事帶來的理想感。

exercises.original: The teacher encouraged the class with stories of former students' success.
exercises.zh: 老師以舊生成功故事鼓舞全班。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher inspired the class with stories of former students' success.

options.explanation: success stories are used to create enthusiasm and aspiration。
forced 會變成強迫，完全不同。
ordered 是下命令。
allowed 是允許。
rewarded 需要提供獎勵。
helped only 太廣，不能表達鼓舞效果。

exercises.original: The exhibition encouraged visitors to think creatively about the future.
exercises.zh: 展覽啟發參觀者以創新方式思考未來。
exercises.upgrade: The exhibition inspired visitors to think creatively about the future.

options.explanation: creative thinking + exhibition 指啟發／靈感，而非命令。
ordered 會把啟發性活動變成指令。
forced 不符自主創意思考。
allowed 只是准許。
praised 需要先有可稱讚的行為。
rewarded 不是展覽帶來創意的方式。

words.example: Officials urged residents to leave the area immediately.
words.exampleZh: 官員敦促居民立即離開該區。

exercises.original: Officials encouraged residents to leave the area immediately.
exercises.zh: 官員敦促居民立即離開該區。
exercises.upgrade: Officials urged residents to leave the area immediately.

options.explanation: officials + immediately 表示強烈、明確行動呼籲。
allow 只是准許離開，力度太弱。
praise 不會要求居民採取安全行動。
help 可能協助撤離，但不是強烈呼籲本身。
reward 不涉及此緊急要求。
inspire 太有理想／情感色彩，不適合緊急指示。

exercises.original: Doctors encourage smokers to stop as soon as possible.
exercises.zh: 醫生敦促吸煙者盡快戒煙。
exercises.upgrade: Doctors urge smokers to stop as soon as possible.

options.explanation: as soon as possible 表示醫生強烈勸告採取行動。
allow 不是勸告。
praise 只適合肯定已作出的改變。
reward 未必存在。
help only 可以支援戒煙，但不能取代強烈建議。
cheer on 太口語，通常用於比賽／努力過程。

exercises.original: The report encourages the government to act before costs rise further.
exercises.zh: 報告敦促政府在成本進一步上升前採取行動。
exercises.upgrade: The report urges the government to act before costs rise further.

options.explanation: report + act before... 是典型正式政策呼籲。
allows the government 會表示給政府許可，角色錯誤。
praises 是稱讚而非呼籲。
rewards 需要提供利益。
helps 不表示要求行動。
reassures 是使安心，與緊迫行動相反。

words.example: Teachers should support students who are nervous about speaking in class.
words.exampleZh: 老師應支持那些對課堂發言感到緊張的學生。

exercises.original: Teachers should encourage students who are nervous about speaking in class.
exercises.zh: 老師應支持並鼓勵對課堂發言感到緊張的學生。
exercises.upgrade: Teachers should support students who are nervous about speaking in class.

options.explanation: nervous students need practical/emotional help，support 最自然。
order 可能增加焦慮。
force 會削弱學生安全感和自主性。
allow only 只是准許發言，不足以提供鼓勵。
reward 不是主要需要。
praise only 可有幫助，但若學生尚未發言便未必有可稱讚表現。

exercises.original: The programme encourages new parents through advice and practical help.
exercises.zh: 計劃透過建議和實際協助支持新手父母。
exercises.upgrade: The programme supports new parents through advice and practical help.

options.explanation: advice + practical help 明確是 support。
orders 不符合協助關係。
forces 不符。
allows 只是准許，不是支援。
praises 不能涵蓋實際協助。
rewards 不是此計劃的主要作用。

exercises.original: Managers should encourage staff during periods of change.
exercises.zh: 經理在變革期間應支持員工。
exercises.upgrade: Managers should support staff during periods of change.

options.explanation: during change 常需要實際與情緒支援，support 比一般 encouragement 更具體。
force 會增加壓力。
order 只是指令。
reward 不等於支持。
allow 不足以表達扶持。
praise only 太窄，不能涵蓋溝通和資源協助。

words.example: The programme promotes regular physical activity among older adults.
words.exampleZh: 這項計劃促進長者定期進行體能活動。

exercises.original: The programme encourages regular physical activity among older adults.
exercises.zh: 這項計劃促進長者定期進行體能活動。
exercises.upgrade: The programme promotes regular physical activity among older adults.

options.explanation: programme encourages a behaviour at population level，promote 是典型公共健康用法。
forces 會表示強迫參與。
orders 不適合公共計劃。
allows 只是准許運動。
praises 不是推動整體行為。
rewards necessarily 未必有任何獎勵機制。

exercises.original: The policy encourages greater participation in vocational training.
exercises.zh: 政策促進更多人參與職業培訓。
exercises.upgrade: The policy promotes greater participation in vocational training.

options.explanation: policy + participation 是典型 promote collocation。
orders 會變成強制參加。
forces 過強。
allows only 只去除障礙，未必積極推動。
praises 不適合政策作用。
helps one person 太窄，原句是整體參與率。

exercises.original: Schools are encouraged to encourage healthy eating.
exercises.zh: 學校獲鼓勵推動健康飲食。
exercises.upgrade: Schools are encouraged to promote healthy eating.

options.explanation: healthy eating 是一項行為／理念，promote 比重複 encourage 更自然。
force healthy eating 會變成強迫。
order healthy eating 句法和政策語感不自然。
allow healthy eating 只表示准許。
reward healthy eating 需要實際獎勵制度。
praise healthy eating 通常是稱讚行為，不能概括長期推廣。

words.example: The question was designed to stimulate discussion among students.
words.exampleZh: 這條問題旨在激發學生之間的討論。

exercises.original: The question was designed to encourage discussion among students.
exercises.zh: 問題旨在激發學生之間的討論。
exercises.upgrade: The question was designed to stimulate discussion among students.

options.explanation: question acts as a trigger that increases discussion activity。
order discussion 不自然且是命令，不是引發。
allow discussion 只是准許。
reward discussion 需要獎勵機制。
praise discussion 不是引發討論。
force discussion 會變成強迫。

exercises.original: The exhibition encourages interest in local history.
exercises.zh: 展覽激發人們對本地歷史的興趣。
exercises.upgrade: The exhibition stimulates interest in local history.

options.explanation: interest is being activated/increased，stimulate interest 是固定搭配。
orders interest 不可能。
allows interest 不是自然因果。
rewards interest 不是展覽本身作用。
forces interest 語義不自然。
helps 太一般，沒有激發反應的意思。

exercises.original: The tax cut was intended to encourage economic activity.
exercises.zh: 減稅旨在刺激經濟活動。
exercises.upgrade: The tax cut was intended to stimulate economic activity.

options.explanation: economic activity + policy measure 是 stimulate 的標準經濟搭配。
allow 只是解除限制。
praise 不適用經濟活動。
order 不能命令整體經濟。
reward directly 不是此宏觀因果表達。
reassure 是使人安心，不等於刺激活動。

words.example: Group work can foster cooperation between students.
words.exampleZh: 小組活動可以培養學生之間的合作。

exercises.original: Group work encourages cooperation between students.
exercises.zh: 小組活動可以培養學生之間的合作。
exercises.upgrade: Group work can foster cooperation between students.

options.explanation: cooperation develops gradually through repeated interaction，foster 最自然。
order cooperation 不能真正建立合作關係。
force cooperation 會削弱自願性。
allow cooperation 只是給空間。
reward cooperation 只是其中一種方法。
praise cooperation 可支持，但不等於長期培養。

exercises.original: The school aims to encourage independence in younger learners.
exercises.zh: 學校旨在培養年幼學習者的獨立性。
exercises.upgrade: The school aims to foster independence in younger learners.

options.explanation: independence is a quality developed over time，foster 很貼切。
force independence 語義矛盾。
order independence 不是培養方式。
allow only 可能有助，但不表示主動培育。
reward 只是可能策略。
praise 是單次回應，不涵蓋長期發展。

exercises.original: Open communication encourages trust within teams.
exercises.zh: 開放溝通有助培養團隊信任。
exercises.upgrade: Open communication fosters trust within teams.

options.explanation: trust develops gradually from repeated open communication。
orders trust 不可能。
forces trust 語義矛盾。
allows trust 太被動。
rewards trust 不自然。
praises trust 不能表達信任形成過程。

words.example: The reminder prompted several customers to renew their subscriptions.
words.exampleZh: 提醒促使數名顧客續訂。

exercises.original: The reminder encouraged several customers to renew their subscriptions.
exercises.zh: 提醒促使數名顧客續訂。
exercises.upgrade: The reminder prompted several customers to renew their subscriptions.

options.explanation: reminder acts as a trigger for a specific action，prompted 最精準。
forced 會表示顧客沒有選擇。
ordered 不符合提醒的性質。
allowed 只給許可。
praised 不是提醒後的作用。
rewarded 需要提供回報。

exercises.original: The report encouraged a wider debate about housing policy.
exercises.zh: 報告引發更廣泛的房屋政策討論。
exercises.upgrade: The report prompted a wider debate about housing policy.

options.explanation: report triggers debate，prompt 是自然因果詞。
forced a debate 過強。
ordered a debate 表示正式命令，原句沒有。
allowed a debate 只是准許。
praised a debate 不是引發。
helped only 太泛，沒有明確觸發意思。

exercises.original: The incident encouraged the organisation to review its procedures.
exercises.zh: 事件促使機構檢討程序。
exercises.upgrade: The incident prompted the organisation to review its procedures.

options.explanation: incident causes a specific review action，prompted 自然。
forced necessarily 太強，事件可促使而非強迫。
ordered 需要有命令者。
allowed 與採取檢討行動不符。
rewarded 不符。
cheered on 適合為人打氣，不適合機構程序。

words.example: She persuaded her colleague to apply for the programme.
words.exampleZh: 她說服同事申請該計劃。

exercises.original: She encouraged her colleague to apply, and he finally agreed.
exercises.zh: 她鼓勵同事申請，而他最終答應了。
exercises.upgrade: She persuaded her colleague to apply.

options.explanation: finally agreed 表示勸說成功，persuaded 比 encourage 更精準。
allowed 只是准許申請。
ordered 會表示上下級命令。
forced 會取消同事的自主決定。
praised 不是說服。
helped 可以協助申請，但不表示改變決定。

exercises.original: After several conversations, they encouraged him to change his mind.
exercises.zh: 經過多次談話，他們說服他改變主意。
exercises.upgrade: After several conversations, they persuaded him to change his mind.

options.explanation: several conversations + changed his mind 是成功說服的直接線索。
forced 表示非自願。
allowed 不表示改變想法。
rewarded 需要誘因回報。
praised 不會直接令他改變決定。
supported only 可以提供支持，但沒有成功改變想法的含義。

exercises.original: The adviser encouraged the client to accept the revised proposal.
exercises.zh: 顧問說服客戶接受修訂方案。
exercises.upgrade: The adviser persuaded the client to accept the revised proposal.

options.explanation: accept the proposal as a result of adviser influence 可用 persuaded。
ordered 不適合顧問與客戶關係。
forced 會暗示脅迫。
allowed 不是說服。
praised 不表示接受方案。
helped 可以協助理解，但不保證同意。

words.example: The app nudges users to take regular breaks.
words.exampleZh: 這個應用程式會輕度提醒使用者定時休息。

exercises.original: The app encourages users to take regular breaks with gentle reminders.
exercises.zh: 應用程式透過溫和提醒促使用者定時休息。
exercises.upgrade: The app nudges users to take regular breaks with gentle reminders.

options.explanation: gentle reminders 明確是低壓、輕推式鼓勵。
forces 與 gentle 完全相反。
orders 是直接命令。
rewards 需要誘因。
praises 是事後肯定。
allows 只是給許可。

exercises.original: A small prompt can encourage customers toward the cheaper option.
exercises.zh: 一個小提示可以輕度促使顧客選擇較便宜的選項。
exercises.upgrade: A small prompt can nudge customers toward the cheaper option.

options.explanation: small prompt + toward a choice 是 behavioural nudge 的典型結構。
force 會取消選擇自由。
order 對顧客不自然。
reward 需要額外利益。
praise 不適合選擇前。
allow 只是讓選項可選。

exercises.original: The message gently encouraged staff to complete the survey.
exercises.zh: 訊息溫和提醒員工完成問卷。
exercises.upgrade: The message gently nudged staff to complete the survey.

options.explanation: gently 是 nudge 的直接線索，表示輕度推動。
forced 程度過強。
ordered 會變成正式要求。
rewarded 需要獎勵。
praised 不會促使未完成的問卷。
allowed 只是准許填寫。

words.example: The teacher reassured the nervous student before the presentation.
words.exampleZh: 老師在匯報前安慰並鼓勵那名緊張的學生。

exercises.original: The teacher encouraged the nervous student before the presentation.
exercises.zh: 老師在匯報前安慰並鼓勵緊張的學生。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher reassured the nervous student before the presentation.

options.explanation: nervous student needs confidence and reduced anxiety，reassure 最精準。
ordered 可能加劇壓力。
forced 不符支持性情境。
rewarded 不是處理緊張的核心方法。
allowed 只是准許做匯報。
praised necessarily 未必已有表現可稱讚。

exercises.original: The doctor encouraged the patient by explaining that the results were normal.
exercises.zh: 醫生解釋結果正常，令病人安心。
exercises.upgrade: The doctor reassured the patient by explaining that the results were normal.

options.explanation: normal results reduce fear and give confidence，reassure 是直接功能。
motivated 重點是行動動力，不是消除擔憂。
ordered 不符。
forced 不符。
rewarded 不涉及。
allowed 不表示安心。

exercises.original: Managers encouraged staff that there would be no job losses.
exercises.zh: 管理層向員工保證不會裁員，使他們安心。
exercises.upgrade: Managers reassured staff that there would be no job losses.

options.explanation: that-clause gives comforting information to reduce anxiety，reassure 最自然。
urged 需要勸對方採取行動。
forced 不符。
ordered 不符。
rewarded 不是提供保障資訊。
praised 不處理對裁員的擔憂。

words.example: Parents cheered on the runners from the side of the track.
words.exampleZh: 家長在跑道旁為跑手打氣。

exercises.original: Parents encouraged the runners from the side of the track.
exercises.zh: 家長在跑道旁為跑手打氣。
exercises.upgrade: Parents cheered on the runners from the side of the track.

options.explanation: runners + track-side support 是 cheer on 的典型場景。
ordered runners 不等於加油。
forced runners 改變成強迫參賽。
allowed 只是准許。
rewarded 需要提供獎賞。
persuaded 是改變決定，不是比賽中的打氣。

exercises.original: The crowd encouraged the home team throughout the match.
exercises.zh: 觀眾整場比賽為主隊打氣。
exercises.upgrade: The crowd cheered on the home team throughout the match.

options.explanation: crowd + throughout the match 是熱情打氣的標準語境。
forced 不可能描述觀眾支持。
ordered 不符。
allowed 不符。
rewarded 並非觀眾的主要行為。
reassured 是消除焦慮，沒有觀眾歡呼含義。

exercises.original: Friends encouraged her as she approached the finish line.
exercises.zh: 她接近終點時，朋友為她加油。
exercises.upgrade: Friends cheered her on as she approached the finish line.

options.explanation: approaching finish line + friends support 是 cheer someone on 的自然搭配。
ordered 不等於加油。
forced 過強且取消自願性。
allowed 不符。
rewarded 通常在完成後或以獎品形式。
persuaded 不適合正在進行的比賽支持。

words.example: Practice can give learners the confidence to speak more freely.
words.exampleZh: 練習可以給予學習者信心，令他們更自在地說話。

exercises.original: Practice encourages learners to speak more freely.
exercises.zh: 練習令學習者更有信心自在地說話。
exercises.upgrade: Practice gives learners the confidence to speak more freely.

options.explanation: speak more freely 表示鼓勵的效果是建立信心。
forces learners 會令說話變成被迫。
orders learners 只是命令發言。
rewards learners 需要獎勵機制。
allows learners only 只是准許。
praises learners 是事後肯定，未必建立足夠信心。

exercises.original: The rehearsal encouraged her to perform in front of a larger audience.
exercises.zh: 綵排令她有信心在更大觀眾前演出。
exercises.upgrade: The rehearsal gave her the confidence to perform in front of a larger audience.

options.explanation: rehearsal reduces uncertainty and builds confidence for performance。
forced her 取消自願性。
ordered her 是外部命令。
rewarded her 不表示心理準備。
allowed her 只是給機會。
praised her only 可能有幫助，但原句重點是綵排本身帶來信心。

exercises.original: Positive feedback encouraged him to ask more questions in class.
exercises.zh: 正面回饋令他更有信心在課堂提問。
exercises.upgrade: Positive feedback gave him the confidence to ask more questions in class.

options.explanation: positive feedback naturally builds confidence to participate。
forced him 與正面支持相反。
ordered him 不表達內在信心提升。
allowed him only 只是許可提問。
rewarded him 未必有任何獎品。
persuaded him necessarily 會暗示成功說服，而這裡更自然是信心增加。

falseSynonyms.zh: 強迫不等於 encourage force 取消或大幅削弱對方選擇；encourage 仍保留自願性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Encouragement influences; force compels.

falseSynonyms.zh: 命令不等於 encourage order 是要求對方必須服從；encourage 通常是支持、勸勉或推動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An order requires compliance; encouragement does not.

falseSynonyms.zh: 稱讚不等於 encourage praise 是肯定已做好的事；它可以鼓勵人，但不是所有 encouragement 都是稱讚。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Praise can encourage, but it is one method rather than a synonym.

falseSynonyms.zh: 獎勵不等於 encourage reward 是提供好處作回報或誘因；鼓勵可以完全沒有獎品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Rewards may encourage behaviour, but they are not encouragement itself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 幫助不等於 encourage help 是提供協助；encourage 是提升意願、信心或支持某行動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Help may enable action without motivating it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 允許不等於 encourage allow 只是沒有阻止；encourage 是積極促進。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Permission is passive; encouragement is active.

falseSynonyms.zh: persuade 只在部分語境接近 encourage persuade 通常暗示對方被成功說服；encourage 不保證行動真的發生。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Persuasion aims at changing a decision; encouragement may simply support.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 encourage 是動詞；encouragement 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Encourage is a verb; encouragement is a noun.
